environment: Owner Mac Studio local Ubuntu ARM64 VM; no GitHub/cloud execution

summary: # Subtest: current feedback recovers fresh VP8 after same-SSRC epoch change and fragment loss without resetting clocks
ok 1 - current feedback recovers fresh VP8 after same-SSRC epoch change and fragment loss without resetting clocks
# Subtest: receiver feedback stays with its exact read across same-ID selection and refuses cloned observations
ok 2 - receiver feedback stays with its exact read across same-ID selection and refuses cloned observations

implementation: Initial nativeAv sender owns a bounded feedback reader, consumes its original hint just before encoding and checks the returned original-age permit. No feedback retry, encoded replay, frame-index reset or timestamp reset.

Receiver clears assembly/decode history on authenticated epoch changes, same-SSRC reselection and detected loss; interframes cannot bootstrap missing history. Recovery requests use the exact owned read, refuse a superseded or in-flight selection, and coalesce at100ms.
Capture includes decoder-history boundaries. Quality analysis starts an independent decoder at each contiguous history and never rejoins a returning camera to its previous decoder.
proved: Actual C/libvpx encoder, RTP packetizer and VP8 assembler recover at original indices2,5,9 after same-SSRC epoch change, dropped middle fragment and expired feedback. Independent FFmpeg processes decode four original marker frames2,5,6,9.
Uncertain consumption propagates once and cannot force another frame. Actual encoder PID is joined.
Exact read identity prevents feedback from old, cloned or superseded same-ID observations.
Two Python cases verify decoder histories remain separate and clocks cannot regress across boundaries.
limits: Feedback authority and authenticated packet metadata are controlled at the SDK boundary in the worker test; this does not prove integrated signed SDK/server transport.
The nativeAv wiring is implemented but this run exercises its extracted workers, not a full six-Connection nativeAv workload.
Server profile and production SDK offers remain disabled. Actual signed SDK/server bootstrap and loss recovery, direct Rust replacement peer and browser integration remain open.
No full transport cell or task promotion; G6-054 deferred.
